title: URLSession: GET & Decode (Mocked)
hints: Cast to `HTTPURLResponse` and check `200..<300` — a 404 is not a thrown error.
Decode `[User]` with `JSONDecoder` after the status check.
jsBridge: `let (data, response) = try await URLSession.shared.data(from: url)` then `JSONDecoder().decode(...)` is `await fetch(url)` then `await res.json()`, except Swift makes you check the status code (fetch doesn't throw on 404, and neither does URLSession).

compass.q: `fetch` resolves on 404. Does `URLSession.data(from:)` throw on 404? What must you check?
What happens if the response isn't JSON (an HTML error page)? Where does it fail?
`URLSession.shared` vs a configured session (timeouts, caching): when do you need your own?
How do you mock `URLSession` in tests (`URLProtocol` subclass)? Why not a protocol wrapper?
